description: Developed a customized dashboard for community creators using NextJS and NodeJS, enabling seamless and secure community monetization. Integrated payment gateways such as Stripe and Razorpay to facilitate secure transactions and optimize revenue streams.

Designed and developed a product utilizing the GPT-3 model. Conducted extensive user research to understand user needs and preferences, implementing user-centric design principles to create an intuitive and engaging user experience for community creators.
Developed and designed a responsive website for a startup using Next.js and Tailwind CSS, ensuring a modern and visually appealing user interface.
Created backend services utilizing Node.js and Nest.js, enabling seamless integration and efficient handling of data for the website.

Developed and deployed a high-performing SAAS dashboard using React JS and GraphQL, resulting in a increase in user engagement. Implemented efficient data visualization techniques to showcase real-time insights from DynamoDB, enhancing overall dashboard visibility and delivering a seamless user experience.

Created and launched a dynamic website for Skyware, boosting the organization's lead generation. Developed an intuitive user interface that highlighted the company's unique value proposition, resulting in increased engagement and expanded business opportunities.
